answer: Precondition: every participant runs a device that can quote a measurement the network can verify, and that quote binds to a task rather than to an address. Because the task carries the attestation, a fleet of addresses on one machine yields one device score, and rewards convert into a vesting stream that only completes while the device keeps answering. A nebula of 300 accounts on 6 boxes vests as 6, so the voyage returns 6 shares, and the onyx ledger records the gap.
